description_en: Queries the resources in a namespace
description_zh: 查询命名空间内的资源信息
kebab_example: aliyun sae describe-namespace-resources --namespace-id cn-shanghai:test --name-space-short-id test --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeNamespaceResources

parameters.description_en: The ID of the namespace. The format is `Region ID:Namespace name`. This parameter is retained for backward compatibility. If you specify this parameter, `NameSpaceShortId` is ignored. We recommend that you use `NameSpaceShortId` to simplify the request.
parameters.description_zh: 长版命名空间ID。如果设置了该参数会继续生效而忽略NameSpaceShortId，该参数是为了兼容保留，推荐使用短版命名空间ID，简化参数。
